summary: Held curl at its current version (8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8) on node1 via apt-mark hold, verified a simulated upgrade skips curl, then completed the mandatory reboot-evidence protocol on node1: captured baseline boot_id and hold status, triggered a native reboot, confirmed the node went unreachable then came back with a new boot_id, and verified curl's version and hold status persisted post-restart.
actions_performed: Checked installed curl version and existing holds on node1 (cmd-17ce939b60cf4ed8)
Simulated apt-get upgrade to confirm curl is kept back while unrelated libcurl3t64-gnutls would still upgrade (cmd-4b7d4f19e3574b81)
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, system health, hold status (cmd-ee3afb32419c43d5)
Triggered native reboot (shutdown -r now) with async ack (cmd-b2825a8610624e32)
Polled node1; confirmed unreachable during reboot (cmd-e41dd638f71e47b7)
Polled node1; confirmed reachable again with new boot_id (cmd-cbe2c3ab4f0349cf)
Verified post-restart system health, curl version, and hold persistence (cmd-c216acdc68744b36)

evidence.requirement: curl held at current version (8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8) so system updates leave it unchanged
evidence.summary: Baseline version identified (8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8), apt-mark hold applied successfully, and a simulated apt-get upgrade confirms curl is excluded from upgrade (kept back) while other packages would proceed.

evidence.requirement: Node1 pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + service/data health)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id bfd05127-56aa-4657-b540-847a25f90491, systemctl is-system-running=running, and curl hold flag 'hi' confirmed before restart.
Reboot command acknowledged asynchronously before disconnect; subsequent poll timed out confirming the node was down/restarting.

evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id is 16959888-d0bf-4d7d-aae8-16959e7dc21b, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving a real reboot occurred (not just a service restart).

evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery and persistence of the curl hold
evidence.summary: After restart, system is fully running, curl remains version 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8 with hold flag 'hi' intact, and the curl binary functions correctly, proving the hold survived the reboot.
